messages.content: who played the oldest brother in 7th heaven

message.content:
The **oldest brother** on *7th Heaven* was **Matt Camden**, played by **Barry Watson**.[3]

If you meant the oldest **Camden sibling overall**, that was Matt as the firstborn son.[3]
